verdict.rationale: smolagents' own docs say it instruments agent runs using the OpenTelemetry standard, so first-party tracing support exists. The pack does not show what is traced or where the traces are viewed. missing for 10: documentation that every LLM call and tool invocation is captured as a span, a named observability UI/backend integration and setup steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: We’ve adopted the OpenTelemetry standard for instrumenting agent runs.
